info.title: MAFW Gateway API — SDK-facing contract
info.description: P4 生成的契约：paths 由 gateway routes/route-catalog.ts 经 emit-openapi 脚本产出（gateway-paths.json），本文件 = gateway-paths.json + overrides.json（手写 summary/description/responseSchema 元数据）合并产物，勿手改。变更链路：route-catalog.ts → (gateway) npm run emit:openapi → (sdk) npm run gen:api → api-schema.gen.ts。tags 含 internal 的 operation 不被 @mafw/sdk 调用（服务端内部/dashboard/mobile 用）。

directory.description: Absolute project directory path (drive, POSIX root, or UNC).

schema.description: kind is a closed enum, and tool is conditionally required when kind is 'tool_call' (missing → 400).

sessionID.description: Session the gate decision is scoped to (required; loopback-only route).

kind.description: Interception point: 'tool_call' before a tool runs, 'prompt' before a prompt is submitted (closed enum; anything else → 400).

tool.description: Tool name. Required when kind is 'tool_call' (missing → 400); ignored for kind:'prompt'.

input.description: Tool arguments for kind:'tool_call' (absent → {}). Free-form: the rule engine interpolates {{field}} from it.

text.description: Prompt text for kind:'prompt' (non-string values are evaluated as ''). Ignored for kind:'tool_call'.

schema.description: sessionID, tool and output.content[] are required (missing → 400).

sessionID.description: Session used for internal-exemption / observability scoping (required).

tool.description: Tool whose output is being rewritten; matched against on:tool_result rules (required).

input.description: Host envelope field from the cognition contract; the current gateway handler does not read it (redaction keys on tool + output.content).

output.description: Tool result envelope. `content` is the only field the gateway reads.

content.description: Tool result content parts. Required and must be an array (otherwise → 400); an empty array is valid.

type.description: Content part type ('text' / 'image' / runtime-specific). Only text parts are redacted; everything else passes through unchanged.

isError.description: Host-side error flag; echoed by the host, not read by the gateway handler.

value.description: Shape depends on category; null clears thought_level.

get.description: Session history as MAFW View DTO (flat MafwMessage: {id,role,content,...}). The legacy {info,parts} envelope and the format opt-in were removed in Task 15.

data.description: Validated against the session output schema at submit time.

transient.description: Not persisted; overrides an existing row for the same id.

maxTurns.description: Rejected when the prompt is queued or the run is suspended.

maxCostUsd.description: Rejected when the prompt is queued or the run is suspended.

name.description: Required for name+source; optional for templates.

source.description: Required with name when template is absent.

name.description: Configured server key; the adapter validates the accepted charset.

type.description: Determines which of url / command the adapter requires.

url.description: Required when type is 'remote'; the adapter validates the URL.

overwrite.description: Replace an existing entry with the same name (absent → conflict error).

replace.description: Explicitly allow a type change for an existing name (absent → conflict error).

name.description: Configured server key to remove (preview only; nothing is written).
Configured server key; the adapter validates the accepted charset.

url.description: Required when type is 'remote'; the adapter validates the URL.

overwrite.description: Replace an existing entry with the same name (absent → conflict error).

replace.description: Explicitly allow a type change for an existing name (absent → conflict error).

token.description: Optimistic-lock token returned by the matching preview call.

confirm.description: Must be literally true; any other value is rejected with 400.

token.description: Optimistic-lock token returned by the preview call.

confirm.description: Must be literally true; any other value is rejected with 400.

backupPath.description: Backup file to restore from; absent → the most recent backup.

token.description: Optimistic-lock token returned by the preview-remove call.

confirm.description: Must be literally true; any other value is rejected with 400.

command.description: Command name including the leading slash form the UI sends (resolved case-insensitively).

args.description: Raw argument string, trimmed and passed to the command handler.

sessionID.description: Session context; a suspended session short-circuits with 409 before running.

projectDir.description: Project whose manager (Lead) session should be rotated.

setCurrent.description: Switch the current project (default false: registration only).

post.description: Real register route persists the registry and broadcasts project_registered.

get.description: ?sessionID= scopes to a session. SDK helper events.url() returns this URL for renderer-direct EventSource (contract in SDK, transport direct).

schema.description: Flat envelope: `type` plus arbitrary payload keys (broadcast verbatim).

type.description: Custom event name; recommended namespace 'plugin:<name>:<event>'. Reserved gateway/runtime names are 400.

plugin.description: Runtime plugin name (loader key or alias); empty/absent rebuilds the configured runtime.

path.description: Absolute local directory of the package to install.

overwrite.description: Replace an installed package of the same name (default false).

requestId.description: Idempotency key; a new iteration must use a fresh value.

path.description: Absolute local directory of the candidate package.

schema.description: Body must be a JSON object shaped as { package } or { type, filename } (never both).

package.description: Unified package name; mutually exclusive with type+filename.

filename.description: Legacy per-type plugin filename; requires type and excludes package.

package.description: Unified package name; mutually exclusive with type+filename.

filename.description: Legacy per-type plugin filename; requires type and excludes package.

input.description: Plugin-defined action payload, passed through verbatim to the committed action registry.

sessionID.description: Session the invocation is attributed to (plugin action context).

revision.description: Client snapshot token; superseded tokens are rejected with 409 stale-revision. Falls back to ?revision=.

projectDir.description: Registered project, known worktree, or a directory below one (canonicalized before the scope check).

sessionID.description: Bind the ticket to one session; absent → project-scoped surface.

schema.description: Gateway config overrides persisted to config.yaml. Unknown keys are written verbatim; omitted keys fall back to defaults.

paths.description: Project and data-root paths (the data root is fixed to ~/.mafw).

loop.description: Loop round caps and degradation factors.

goal.description: Goal node model overrides and eval switches.

logging.description: Log directory, rotation size and level.

recall.description: Recall instruction surface, worker and boundary-recall parameters.

events.description: Persistent event log switches and retention.

runtime.description: Active runtime plugin name and per-plugin config index.

resources.description: Resource ledger watermarks and connection/quota limits (0 = unlimited).

schema.description: Runtime-native Config merge document (shape owned by the active runtime; gateway forwards it verbatim).

approve.description: true approves; false/absent rejects, and feedback is then required (handler 400).

feedback.description: Rejection reason; required when approve is not true.

approvalId.description: Must equal the pending approval id; missing/stale → 409.

evalHash.description: Declared Goal Eval hash; mismatch → 409 stale_plan.

projectDir.description: Defaults to MAFW_PROJECT_DIR / cwd when absent (handler projectDirOf).

reviewAt.description: ISO date for the review reminder; invalid dates are 400.

projectDir.description: Defaults to MAFW_PROJECT_DIR / cwd when absent (handler projectDirOf).

reviewAt.description: ISO date; null keeps the draft value.

projectDir.description: Defaults to MAFW_PROJECT_DIR / cwd when absent (handler projectDirOf).

reviewAt.description: Required ISO date (when the shelved record resurfaces).

projectDir.description: Defaults to MAFW_PROJECT_DIR / cwd when absent (handler projectDirOf).

runId.description: Failed node run to replay; absent = latest failed run in the active revision.

config.description: Source-adapter specific config, stored verbatim (owner: each event source adapter).

projectDir.description: Defaults to MAFW_PROJECT_DIR / cwd when absent (handler projectDirOf).

mode.description: work = wake the subscriber; context = inject context only.

schema.description: Source-defined JSON payload, passed verbatim to the event source adapter (signature / idempotency are header- and raw-body-based).

projectDir.description: Absolute path; absent falls back to MAFW_PROJECT_DIR / cwd (handler projectDirOf).

triggers.description: At least one trigger; parseStandingTriggers 400s on empty arrays or unknown types.

goalTitle.description: Goal title for the forked topic; blank = derived default.

confirm.description: Required (true) when the node is execute; other nodes can retry without a body.

type.description: cancel abandons the question; answer (or any other value) forwards `answer` to the driver.

post.description: Desktop QuestionWidget. Distinct from /api/questions/{id}/reply (native opencode question API).

projectDir.description: Project hint for goal start; absent = resolve from the goal row.

goalId.description: Target goal; not read for RESET_PARAMETRIC.

targetPhase.description: Only FORCE_PHASE: next phase name (upper-cased by the handler).

post.description: PAUSE/ABORT/FORCE_PHASE/RESET_PARAMETRIC. Gateway also accepts legacy POST /control (MCP handler compat) - same handler.

id.description: Harmonic memory id; unknown ids return 200 {success:false}.

pinned.description: Only read when sticky is absent: pinned === true pins, anything else unpins.

sticky.description: Presence of a boolean switches to note-board mode (true → expire at stickyDays).

stickyDays.description: Note-board window in days when sticky is true; absent/<=0 → 7.

schema.description: At least one field is required ({} → 400). baseUrl is config-file only and is rejected here.

model.description: Provider model id (free-form; validated by the provider at runtime).

llamacpp.description: llama.cpp-only knobs; ignored by the ONNX engine.

answer.description: Free-text answer (MCP ask_user widget). Required unless decision is present; wins when both are given.

post.description: Dismiss = reject alias (state REJECTED), ledger reason triage_dismissed. Route added 2026-09-17 fixing SDK drift bug.

priority.description: Defaults to medium; unknown values are coerced to medium.

reason.description: Why the skill is deopted; absent/blank → "manual". Truncated to 200 chars.

answers.description: One array of selected option labels per question, in question order.

message.description: Optional note forwarded to the runtime reply.

persist.description: Only read for reply:'always' — rule scope for the auto-persisted allow rule.

mode.description: 'manual' is a legacy alias normalized to read-only.

prefix.description: Argument prefix scope; blank = tool-wide entry.
Must match the stored prefix; blank = tool-wide entry.

pattern.description: Argument pattern; trailing * is stripped. Blank = tool-wide rule.
Must match the stored pattern; blank = tool-wide rule.

message.description: Prompt text (required; empty → 400). Sent as a single text part.

schema.description: message or parts is required (both absent → 400).

message.description: Prompt text (excluding parts). Required when parts is absent.

parts.description: Extra runtime prompt parts (file/agent attachments); required when message is absent.

sessionID.description: Reuse this session; absent → a new session in the first registered project.

agent.description: Runtime agent name override for this prompt.

schema.description: At least one engine (top-level or per-modality) is required; none → 400.

engine.description: Default media engine for every modality (absent → unchanged).
Media engine plugin name, or "pi" (always available).

post.description: Raw octet-stream, ?type=. Must go through Node network stack (Chromium fetch hangs behind system proxies). SDK helper media.upload().

post.summary: Upload + A2A task create in one round-trip

get.description: TTS audio / uploaded media. Consumed directly by <audio src> via SDK media.artifactUrl() helper - transport stays direct.

style.description: Prosody/style instruction for engines that support it.
Prosody/style instruction for engines that support it.

sessionId.description: Session key for the in-flight set (barge-in target); absent → untracked stream.

post.description: SSE of base64 PCM16 chunks (24kHz mono). SDK helper tts.streamUrl() returns this URL; transport stays renderer-direct (IPC cannot clone the SSE stream).

sessionId.description: Session whose in-flight TTS streams are aborted (required; empty → 400).

schema.description: At least one of recall / goal / media is required (none → 400).

recall.description: Worker model; flat pair in the request (workerModel envelope is response-only).

providerID.description: Worker model provider id (required within recall).
Goal node model provider; both providerID and modelID empty = reset to identity model.

modelID.description: Goal node model id; half-empty pair → 400.

techLeadModel.description: Tech Lead model override; both empty = reset; half-empty pair → 400.

provider.description: Default media provider; both provider and model empty = reset to built-in default.

image.description: Empty pair (both "") = reset to the built-in default; partial pairs fall back for validation.

video.description: Empty pair (both "") = reset to the built-in default; partial pairs fall back for validation.

audio.description: Empty pair (both "") = reset to the built-in default; partial pairs fall back for validation.

enabled.description: Target enabled state; persisted verbatim by toggleRule (missing value is stored as unset).

id.description: Rule id; draftRule always returns valid:false without it (200, not 400).

schedule.description: Cron expression; required when type is cron/absent (validateRule error otherwise).

on.description: Event kinds to subscribe; required (non-empty) when type is event.

perGoalCooldown.description: Per-goal debounce window (e.g. 60s/5m); defaults to 5m, must match /^\d+(s|m|h)$/.

skill.description: Skill to run; at least one of skill/action is required by validateRule.

args.description: Skill / action input, owner: the action handler.

action.description: External action payload; unresolved action types fail validateRule.

type.description: Builtin action type or a plugin-center registered external action.

goalId.description: Required for plan tasks (plan:true or waveId set).

anchor.description: PodReviewAnchor: quote / jsonPath / cell / region (stored verbatim).

code.description: Python source to execute in the persistent kernel (required).

timeoutMs.description: Execution timeout override; non-number values are ignored.

schema.description: JSON observation envelope. Missing/invalid sessionID or source → 400; any other error → fail-open 200 {ok:false}.

content.description: Observation text; empty → 200 {deduped:true} without a T1 write. Truncated to 100k after redaction.

failure.description: Mark the row as a failed/errored step (stored as 0/1).

content.description: Memory body (trimmed; empty → 400). Stored truncated to 4000 chars.

importance.description: Salience hint (1-10 recommended); any finite number is accepted, absent → judgeSalience().

primaryAbstraction.description: 6-8 word index abstraction; absent → the content, truncated to 200 chars.

cueAnchors.description: Retrieval keywords (identifiers kept verbatim); extra items are dropped.

pinned.description: Pin to the per-turn <user-profile> disclosure layer.

sticky.description: Put the memory on the note board (expires, never deleted).

stickyDays.description: Note-board window in days when sticky is true; absent/<=0 → 7.

sessionID.description: Originating session; pipeline worker ids resolve back to their source session.

sourceTraceIds.description: Exact T1 trace ids (unknown ids are dropped, not rejected).

goalId.description: Target goal; not read for RESET_PARAMETRIC.

targetPhase.description: Only FORCE_PHASE: next phase name (upper-cased by the handler).

artifactId.description: Artifact id returned by media.upload / media.uploadAndCreate.

question.description: Follow-up question appended as a text part; absent → media-only task.

mediaType.description: Override the artifact content type; absent → recorded type or application/octet-stream.

dataUrl.description: data: URL of the audio payload (required; empty → 400).

prompt.description: Custom analysis prompt; absent → the narrative (content + prosody + intent) pass.

question.description: Follow-up question (required; blank → 400). External URLs are rejected.

token.description: FCM push token reported by the app (required); never a gateway credential.

platform.description: Client platform label, e.g. android / ios (required).

deviceName.description: Human-readable label; ignored by the mobile alias path (persisted by pairing instead).

deviceId.description: Stable device id; absent → a generated uuid. Invalid chars/length → 400.

rotate.description: Required true to re-pair a device that already holds a credential (else 409).

id.description: Device id; absent → the transport-resolved principal.deviceId (legacy fallback).

token.description: Presented token; the server derives apiTokenHash from it (required).

post.summary: Rotate the human token and bind it live

schema.description: Either { event: {...}, plugin? } or a bare runtime-native event object.

event.description: Runtime-native event payload (adapter-owned). Omit to treat the top-level object itself as the event.

plugin.description: Apply this runtime plugin’s event mapping table before normalization; absent → identity.

scenarios.description: Scenario ids to run (unknown ids are ignored); absent → every scenario.

timeoutMs.description: Per-scenario observation window; non-number values are ignored.

approved.description: Legacy boolean form, only read when reply is absent (true → once, false → reject).

message.description: Optional note forwarded to the runtime reply.

persist.description: Only read for reply:'always' — rule scope for the auto-persisted allow rule.

schema.description: OpenAI-compatible chat completion request (unknown fields tolerated).

model.description: Echoed back in the completion; absent → the configured main-agent model.

messages.description: Chat history (a user message with text or media is required).

items.description: Chat message; unknown fields are ignored by the adapter.

role.description: OpenAI role (system | user | assistant | …); the last user message drives the run.

items.description: text | image_url | input_audio | video_url part (EvalScope shapes).

observations.description: Observation texts to compress (must be an array; empty array is valid).

model.description: Model id override for the compression run; absent → runtime default.

sourceWorktree.description: Absolute source worktree path (memory root is <worktree>/<paths.mafwDir>).

strategy.description: manual | higher_energy | newer; unknown values behave like manual.

resolveStrategy.description: Legacy alias, read only when strategy is absent; defaults to manual.

name.description: Tool name from GET /api/tools (unknown → 404 + available list).

sessionID.description: Session the tool registration surface is built for; absent → empty id.

params.description: Tool-defined argument object, passed through verbatim.
